snippet.title: DREAMS OF SATURN 3.0 - FIRST LOOK TRAILER
snippet.description:
DREAMS OF SATURN 3.0 - FIRST LOOK TRAILER

From George and Joe Kitchen, we have the first look at Dreams of Saturn 3.0!

With Shenmue heart and SEGA references galore, this is THE game to play over the holiday period!

Launching December 19th on Shenmuedojo.com - download links to follow!

Join this channel to get access to perks:
